description:
Moon Sunwoo spends his days farming items in the virtual reality game "Final Kingdom" to repay a debt. After narrowly escaping a trap disguised as a job, he finds a hidden quest to awaken a mysterious woman who has lost all her memories while trapped inside a crystal. Though initially skeptical, Sunwoo discovers that she seemingly knows everything about the game. Can the two work together as Sunwoo helps the amnesic game connoisseur recover her memories while she guides him through the game?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/61793190), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12835292), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/4954007378), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/gamejalal), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/gamjalal), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000071063)
